title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 + MTP settings reference for a custom vLLM image
status: Reusable settings reference. Documentation only; not an installation recipe or an automatically applied default.

evidence_basis.scope: Original configuration captured by Gate Genie and independently compared with full Docker metadata. A subsequent deployment of the selected repaired image was checked through actual APIs, installed package queries and resource hashes; measurements are summarized below. No public image-build reproducibility claim.

checkpoint.verification_history: Historical model verification is recorded; the later capture compared file sizes without recomputing hashes. Verify weights in your own installation.

runtime_dependency_inventory.image: Custom repaired local image. Installed packages queried during selected-image qualification: vLLM 0.29.0, torch 2.13.0+cu130 and transformers 5.16.1. CUDA_VERSION declares 13.0.2 and NVARCH declares sbsa; inherited labels alone do not establish build ancestry. The complete public build recipe remains unavailable here; stock vLLM compatibility is unproven.

custom_artifacts_required.purpose_recorded: Launcher describes a disk-mapped PLE table; only model and cache mounts were inspected. A distinct table mount is not established.

runtime_dependency_inventory.hardware_class_declared: Launcher describes a single DGX Spark / GB10 with a 128 GB pool. Physical hardware and required driver were not measured.

recreation_gaps: Exact image build recipe and custom source modifications were not established by this inspection; stock vLLM compatibility is not certified.
PLE mmap table generation/provenance and the exact patch set naming the qwen4_exp_*/ple/qsa ops: undocumented here.
Current weight integrity was not established by a fresh hash pass.

Actual text, tools, vision, cold-to-warm cache reuse, context boundary and reasoning EOS checks passed on the selected image. Sustained work, exhaustive maximum-length output, MTP performance and fresh-machine recreation remain unqualified.
evaluation_gaps: No new matched Hourglass benchmark was run during this deployment qualification.
Positive prefix-cache reuse was measured; comparative MTP speed/quality and draft-vocabulary tradeoffs were not benchmarked.
restoration_note: Keep your working image, container and configuration. Prepared recreation arguments are not evidence of a completed restore. This reference includes no restore guarantee.
uncertainty_flags: Installed package versions were queried; version labels alone do not reproduce the custom image or certify stock compatibility.
Hardware class comes from launcher text; hardware and driver requirements were not measured.
A reusable reference does not certify an installation-specific gateway route or recovery binding.
max_new_tokens=262144 is pinned natively via --override-generation-config; no separate gateway-level output cap is established.
environment_scope: Four inherited image build metadata entries are omitted from this reference. The complete image environment and build recipe are required for recreation; this JSON is a settings reference.
review_note: Original profile prepared by Gate Genie; source metadata and subsequent selected-image deployment evidence independently checked by Codex. Public summary omits installation identifiers. Existing command and environment defaults are preserved.

qualification.scope: Two deployments of the same selected image, independently checked through actual endpoints and runtime metadata. Installation-specific identities and complete receipts remain private.
